name: Plain Text Tables
tip: Click a cell of a table in Live Preview to edit the table as Markdown text. Move the cursor out of the table and Obsidian draws it again.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Plain Text Tables is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.

related.name: Footnotes in Callouts and Tables
related.blurb: Show footnote references in callouts and tables as numbered links.

related.name: Table Row Links
related.blurb: Copy links to marked rows of a Markdown table.

related.name: Paragraph Enter
related.blurb: Press Enter once to start a new paragraph.
